learnings.text: The parser uses a segmentation strategy that splits on user messages but keeps tool-result messages in the same segment as the preceding assistant tool-use. This prevents splitting mid-interaction.
ToolResultBlock content is truncated to 500 chars (head+tail) when the original exceeds that limit. The original_length field preserves the pre-truncation size for debugging.

The project uses pydantic discriminated unions (Field(discriminator='type')) for content blocks, which means all block types must have a literal 'type' field. Adding a new block type requires updating the ContentBlock union.
